name: CA-33
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+7 district with a well-funded incumbent
Aguilar has $3.5M on hand; challenger has no reported fundraising

model.rationale: Aguilar is an incumbent in a D+7 seat with a large cash advantage and no outside spending against him, while Stephanie Vargas has no reported fundraising. Markets price his win odds near 95%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Aguilar would be the first sign the race is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Pete Aguilar, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a Southern California district that leans Democratic by about seven points. He enters the general election with a strong financial position, having raised over $4.7 million and holding $3.5 million on hand, with no outside groups spending against him.

Republican challenger Stephanie Vargas has reported no fundraising, and no public polls or expert ratings cover the race. Prediction markets give Aguilar roughly a 95% chance of winning. With the fundamentals, money, and market pricing all aligned, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, though the absence of polling keeps confidence at medium.
